title: KoolSMPCore
body:
# You need Vault in order for this plugin to work!!!!!

## Looking for Developers!!

If you would like to help out with KoolSMPCore, feel free to join our Discord and contact either me (gamingto12) or 0x7694C9 (Lead Developer). Development has been slowing down and we would like to keep the plugin moving, help us out if you can!

### Plugin Description

KoolSMPCore is a powerful and versatile Minecraft server management plugin designed to give you complete control over your community. It features a robust custom punishment and banning system to keep your server safe and fair, along with an extensive collection of commands tailored for administration, regular gameplay, and fun interactions.

Key features include:

Custom Punishment & Banning Systems — flexible, easy to manage, and tailored to your needs

Extensive Command Suite — administration tools, player commands, and fun features for your community

Advanced Reports System — keep track of player reports and moderation actions efficiently

Integration Bridges — seamless compatibility with Vault, LuckPerms, DiscordSRV, and EssentialsXDiscord for smooth permissions and chat management

Highly Configurable Chat Formats — customize chat and cosmetic formats to match your server’s style

Powerful Chat Filter — supports regex patterns to prevent unwanted content and maintain a friendly environment
Whether you’re running a small private server or a large public community, this plugin offers the flexibility and tools you need to moderate effectively and create a fun, engaging experience for your players.

# Support Server

You can find our support/primary Discord server @ https://discord.gg/MTYrSgVkmd. Here, you can ask any questions you have about the plugin as well as shout out ideas or other things you would like to see added or changed in the plugin. All are welcome!
